visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text with a country dropdown and Find now link beside an illustration
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile; select and CTA side by side from 600px; two columns from 900px

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells. Text cell: heading, paragraph, bullet list of countries (each item a link to that country's provider finder; an optional first plain-text item is the placeholder, e.g. "Select your country"), then the Find now link. Image cell: illustration
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Text side (heading, paragraph, country selector, Find now link) beside doctor illustration

usage.description: Find-your-local-provider section on the home page.

reuseGuidance: Use whenever a CTA destination depends on a user-chosen country/region. The Find now link uses its own URL until a country is chosen.
